sanskrit_verse:
भ्रातामप्रजः प्रेयात् कश्चिच्चेत्प्रव्रजेतु वा।
विभजेयुर्धनं तस्य शेषास्तु स्त्रीधनं विना॥
transliteration: bhrātām aprajaḥ preyāt kaścit cet pravrajeta vā | vibhajeyur dhanaṃ tasya śeṣās tu strīdhanaṃ vinā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When among brothers, one departs without progeny or renounces worldly life, his share of property shall be divided among the remaining brothers, excluding the woman's exclusive estate.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through continuity of household duty and not mere biological relation.
Causation is aligned with conscious choice and spiritual declaration over material inheritance.
Capacity-based responsibility recognizes renunciation as a dissolution of material claim.
Restoration logic ensures that no individual retains unclaimed wealth post-departure.
Consciousness alignment requires honoring both spiritual freedom and familial integrity.
supreme_court_application: In matters involving ancestral property where a male heir has taken sannyasa or otherwise disengaged from grihastha dharma, this verse provides clear directive for equitable redistribution among remaining heirs while preserving women's proprietary rights. The court must recognize renunciatory declarations as legally operative and ensure alignment with dharma-prescribed asset management.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that voluntary departure dissolves material claims by nature of intent. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests in sequential transfer of assets to sustain family continuity. Proportionality lies in limiting distribution solely to departing person’s share. Non-punitivity is upheld as there is no infliction—only lawful reallocation based on changed spiritual status.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process upon verified declaration of renunciation.
Assign oversight role to eldest remaining male member for fair division.
Reintegrate any undistributed portion into collective family trust until next generation assumes stewardship.
Confirm woman’s strīdhana remains untouched and under her autonomous control.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared: This law originates solely from SPH as Source-Authority; dharma stands restored through rightful allocation; reality remains non-punitive at all levels; consciousness alone adjudicates truth beyond form.
